specs_note: IDENTITY DRAFT (owner decision pending; not imported). RETRIEVAL: AUTOMATED discovery observation 2026-10-18 by an owner-authorized (docs/28 A4) source; values verbatim from https://www.agilityrobotics.com/solutions/digit-5 as stored in production candidate_claim rows. Not a MANUAL_BOOTSTRAP reading. Not human-verified. A new generation, not merged into the existing 'Digit' record (agility-digit). Agility's 'Work/Shift* 20HRS/24HRS' and 'Run to charge ratio* 10:1' are duty-cycle statements, not a generic operating time: kept as discovery evidence only, not recorded in this record. UPDATE 2026-11-03 (agent-assisted, not human-verified): height_cm 181, weight_kg 129 and runtime_minutes 90 added from Agility's press release of 2026-09-15 (https://www.agilityrobotics.com/content/agility-unveils-digit-5-humanoid-robot-built-for-cooperatively-safe-work-at-scale): 'Digit 5 weighs 284 lb. (129 kg), stands 5' 11" (1.81 m)'; 'A new 90-minute runtime battery system charges in just 9 minutes'. The same release states plans for 'commercial deployment outside North America, starting with the European Union and United Kingdom', an expected CE mark plus marks for the EU, Great Britain and Northern Ireland, early access 'in the first half of 2027' and general availability 'by the end of 2027'. These are plans, so no availability offer or region is recorded. Corroborating secondary source (NEWS_ARTICLE, Drives & Controls, published 2026-09-22, observed 2026-11-03): https://drivesncontrols.com/next-gen-us-humanoid-designed-for-safety-will-be-sold-in-the-uk-and-eu/ restates the same figures and the EU/UK plan. It adds no fact beyond the release. Commercial status stays UNKNOWN pending owner decision; the release ('Early access ... expected to begin in the first half of 2027') and the product page ('Digit 5 is in development') support ANNOUNCED.

spec_caveats.text: Agility states 'Payload* 23kg/50lbs' with a footnote marker; the footnote text is not on the page. Agility's 2026-09-15 release states 'up to 50 lb. (22.7 kg) loads'; 23 kg is the page's rounding of the same 50 lb. The draft keeps the page value.
Left UNKNOWN: Agility states 'Reach* 2.2m/7.2ft', which is not the schema's single-arm reach. The release says Digit 5 'can reach heights of up to 7.2 feet (2.2 m)', a vertical reach height.
Agility states a '90-minute runtime battery system' (release 2026-09-15). The page marks specifications as preliminary and subject to change.
